why: Owner 27 Oct: "พวกแมพเอาจากตรงนี้" (EmbassyWorld_Map_Standalone_2026-10-27.zip, the accepted 26 Oct map of the sales gallery) and chose "แผนที่จริง + motion ตามเสียง": the location and nearby stories draw on the real map instead of the schematic disc. scripts/render_story_maps.py renders each base from that map (its own OSM data, palette and the project's 3D model; wider tiles from OpenFreeMap) and projects every pin and route onto it; the robot face draws the motion over the picture. Every place below is checked against the approved report before it is drawn: its straight-line km from the report's own start pin (Haversine, the report's method) and the drive route's km against the report's road km. A place with no checked coordinate gets no pin -- the schools' story stays the drive-time rings (Regents, Mooltripakdee and Rugby have none: report 92 says so for Rugby; OSM/Nominatim found none of the three on 27 Oct).
